basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old music enthusiast currently residing in Austin, Texas. I recently graduated with a degree in Biology but have always had a passion for indie music and literature. I spend my evenings exploring new music, reading contemporary novels, and engaging in discussions about the latest indie releases. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which allows me to keep up with the latest in both music and literature. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time at local gigs or finding new hiking trails. I'm usually online late at night, as that's when I find the best time to dive into deep discussions on Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in biology from my university education, but my true passion lies in indie music and literature. I often self-educate by reading music blogs, listening to new albums, and participating in book clubs. My job at the bookstore helps me stay informed about the latest trends and releases in these areas.
